name: Chesapeake & Ohio Canal NHP, Spring Gap Campground
skip_reason: Largest drive-in sites cap under 23 ft. A genuine NPS drive-in campground (C&O Canal NHP mile 173.3 off MD-51 at Oldtown, 12 single drive-in sites plus two drive-in group sites, hand-pump well water Apr 15-Nov 1, chemical toilets, boat ramp to the Potomac) and correctly a federal rescue from RV Life's 'commercial' tag - but the NPS site list says only sites 3-7, 12 and 14 take an RV/trailer/pop-up and caps those at 'a small 20 ft length or smaller', with no hookups. EKKO is 23 ft, so it fails the minimum-site-length rule. Recorded rather than dropped silently because the reason is length, not validity: if the park ever re-rates those sites the entry would qualify.
